title: mini-agents-seed-applied-v1
description: Confirmation the process writes to <seed-file>.applied.json after it plants a seed and before it starts the server. The file is the only report of the seed; the agent can read the state-summary tool, so the target reports nothing through a tool.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the seed file's bytes.

slots.description: Slot id of each applied item, in file order.
